$comment: Shared by ts/tests/adapters/claude-family-sessionlog.test.ts and tests/adapters/test_claude_family_session_logs.py. Two evidence tiers: 'installedCapture' is Main's isolated run of the installed 2.1.220 binary against a localhost synthetic provider (no real account); 'sourceQualification' is what was read from that binary's embedded bundle. Neither is a release-latest claim.

encoding.note: dot, space, underscore and accented letter; matches Main's installed 2.1.220 capture
NFD input is not re-normalized by the sanitizer itself; canonicalization applies NFC before encoding
astral char is two UTF-16 units, so two hyphens
over 200 chars: 200-char prefix plus '-' and base36(abs(djb2(path)))
non-ASCII hash input uses UTF-16 code units

legacyLayout.$comment: The pre-TWA-96 helper only replaced '/' and '_' with '-'. Transcripts placed under that name for a workdir containing any other non-alphanumeric character must not be found.

telemetry.$comment: session.jsonl repeats message.id msg_01 across two content-block lines (counted once), carries a <synthetic> placeholder (ignored for model) and no cost field (cost derived from claude-sonnet-4-6 pricing).
